name: doingzone-zcode
description: 打更人插件市场 — ZCode 桌面端夜间无人值守守护:崩溃拉起、卡死重启、429 忙碌无限重试(时段可配)、升级补丁自愈、战报可查。

plugins.name: zcode-nightwatch
plugins.description: 打更人 —— ZCode 桌面无人值守守护:计划任务每 30 分钟巡更(崩溃点灯拉起/卡死拍醒,pythonw 零闪窗)、429 忙碌自动排队重试(时段可配,退避封顶 60s 插进去为止)、升级后客户端补丁自动重打(node 预检避让残缺文件)、战报一条命令可查。装上即在岗:SessionStart 钩子每次会话启动静默自愈。

description_i18n.en: Nightwatch — a silent Windows scheduled-task guardian for unattended ZCode runs: relaunches crashed instances, restarts hung ones, endless start-plan 429 busy-retry (time-window gated), auto re-applies client patches after ZCode upgrades (pre-flight syntax check), battle reports via one command. Zero-touch: a SessionStart hook self-heals on every session start.
